items.name: page-container
items.title: Page Container
items.description: The frame of a page: full width, responsive padding, and the spacing between its sections.
items.docs: Wrap each page in PageContainer. Content rendered inside another page, such as an inline child route or a tab panel, adds none of its own.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: The heading of a page: its title, an optional description, and page-level actions.
items.docs: Render PageHeader once per page, as the first child of its PageContainer.

items.name: route-dialog
items.title: Route Dialog
items.description: A child route presented as a centered modal dialog, opened and closed by its URL.
items.docs: Return RouteDialog from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

items.name: route-drawer
items.title: Route Drawer
items.description: A child route presented as a modal panel at the right edge, opened and closed by its URL.
items.docs: Return RouteDrawer from the component of a child route, and call useRouteOverlay() only from inside it. The close button is translated under routeOverlay.close; add it to your locale resources (Close, 关闭), or it reads Close in every language.

items.name: route-child-page
items.title: Route Child Page
items.description: A child route presented as a non-modal page covering the content area, keeping the page beneath mounted.
items.docs: Return RouteChildPage from the component of a child route. It covers the nearest positioned ancestor, so render its outlet beside the parent page's container rather than inside it.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: A date field opened from a button: one day, or a range across two months.
items.docs: DatePicker and DateRangePicker render a button that opens a Calendar in a Popover. The trigger text is translated under datePicker.placeholder and datePicker.rangePlaceholder; add them to your locale resources (Pick a date / 选择日期, Pick a date range / 选择日期范围), or they read English in every language.

items.name: date-time-picker
items.title: Date Time Picker
items.description: A date and time field: one moment, or a start and an end on the day the calendar selects.
items.docs: DateTimePicker builds on DatePicker and installs date-picker.tsx with it; installing date-picker first finds the file already in place. mode='single', the default, returns one moment; mode='range' returns a DateTimeRange, a start and an end on the day the calendar selects. The labels are translated under dateTimePicker.time, dateTimePicker.startTime, dateTimePicker.endTime, dateTimePicker.clear and dateTimePicker.confirm; add them to your locale resources (Time / 时间, Start Time / 开始时间, End Time / 结束时间, Clear / 清除, Confirm / 确认), or they read English in every language.
